samples.text: The requirement to notify the client of a personal data breach changes from a mandatory obligation to a discretionary one. [1] becomes [2]. This change replaces a strict obligation with a standard of "reasonable efforts," potentially lowering the level of certainty in the provider's responsibility to notify.
